snippet.title: ENDLESS Legend 2 - Kin of Sheredyn Faction Spotlight | Fantasy 4X
snippet.description:
Meet the Kin of Sheredyn, one of the various playable factions in Endless Legend 2. In this first faction spotlight, Derek Paxton (Game Director) shares an overview of this unique faction, descendants of an expedition sent by a mighty interstellar empire. Will you lead the Kin of Sheredyn to victory?
